scenarios.material_change: The route threat stands at (72,31), adjacent to Jinju and to the exposure tile (73,31) but two tiles from the horses, so the horses stay outside its zone of control and the escort attacks it directly from the city; exposure happens on (73,31), not on the scored resource; the escort leaves to the road tile (73,29) and can step back; the escort holds 5 hp; the Jeonju builder starts on the quarry (67,23) so the mine is one hills step away.
scenarios.reason: Live 2026-10-10 (builder-a1 validate, 5 of 13 cases failed): Civ VI zone of control empties a civilian's movement when it enters a tile adjacent to an enemy military unit (the Jinju builder reached the horses with 0 of 4 moves, HasMovedIntoZOC true), so a pasture next to the route threat can never be built on the turn the builder arrives, and a melee unit that enters zone of control cannot attack that turn, so the escort's lethal attack from two tiles away never resolved. joint-full could not score 12 and the Jeonju-to-mine leg (two hills tiles) consumed all four moves.
